title: GrokPtah Computer Use operator trust root
description: Operator/release declaration of the packaged identities Computer Use admission compares against. This file must live OUTSIDE the artifact root it authorizes; a trust root found inside that root is refused, because whoever produced the artifact would then also be declaring what it is checked against.

issuer.description: Operator label (release channel, build id). Advisory only; nothing is admitted on the strength of this string.

teamId.description: Apple Team ID, exactly 10 alphanumeric characters.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256. A single SHA-256 over the bytes, matching crypto.createHash("sha256").

designatedRequirement.description: Verbatim requirement as codesign -d -r- emits it. Compared for exact equality after whitespace normalization; it must bind its own identifier and pin a certificate anchor.

provenance.description: Bound identity token. No path separators and no traversal; it names a release, not a location.

authorizationSha256.description: Digest of the release-side authorization for this image. Read only from this file; a manifest shipped beside the image cannot supply it.
